query:
Diagnose this workflow problem and explain the root cause and the correct fix direction:

User wants a Wan 2.2 14B T2V workflow; adapting the I2V example manually produced a variety of errors.

desired.outcome: Convert the I2V workflow: delete/disable LoadImage and WanVideo Image2Video Encode nodes, replace sampler image_embeds with WanVideo Empty Embeds, switch model/loras to T2V versions. OP confirmed it works without error.
desired.quality: Diagnosis names the correct root cause (matching the recorded root cause) and proposes the fix direction; depth of reasoning matters more than exact wording.
desired.answer_guidance: Convert the I2V workflow: delete/disable LoadImage and WanVideo Image2Video Encode nodes, replace sampler image_embeds with WanVideo Empty Embeds, switch model/loras to T2V versions. OP confirmed it works without error.
desired.guidance_note: Known fix from the original issue thread. Use to verify the diagnosis targets the right root cause; alternative fixes that resolve the same root cause are acceptable.

_tags.hidden_requirement: Know exactly which structural changes convert a WanVideoWrapper I2V workflow to T2V (drop LoadImage + Image2Video Encode, swap to Empty Embeds, T2V checkpoints/loras).
